title: Design: A/R Collection PDF prints the call list on each customer's line
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Your role has the "View and Manage AP/AR Data" switch on.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has an overdue invoice, a phone number and a credit term.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST D-46 PDF Phone.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/R Collection is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu, with only {Customer-A} ticked.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Download the PDF from the ⋯ menu and open it at 100%.
  2. Read the lines under the title.
  3. Read {Customer-A}'s line.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the PDF opens.
  • Step 2: "As of " and the date, then "Locations: All locations", then "Customer: " and the name.
  • Step 3: the name, "Phone: " and the number, "Credit term: " and the term, on the customer's line; nothing overlaps.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV), story SV-11539 (Story 9, A/R Collection call list)

  • S9-R3: “The PDF prints the same phone and credit term on each customer's line; the CSV carries them in columns (S3-R8a).”
  • S3-R4: “Each export states the as-of date the user picked: the PDF "As of Oct 15, 2026", the CSV "As of: Oct 15, 2026" (format: three-letter month, day, four-digit year).”
  • S3-R5: “Each export states the locations under the as-of line: "Locations: All locations" when every location is ticked, otherwise "Locations: " followed by the ticked locations' names. Under it, only when set: "Past due: " and the ticked ranges in menu order (for example "Past due: 31-60 days, 91+ days"), then, for one ticked customer or vendor, "Customer: " or "Vendor: " and the name, and for several, "Customers: " or "Vendors: " and the names in the order they were ticked.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), page 2 (Export) and page 7 (Filters and call list) as the PRD names it.
